{{Youmay|the electromagnetic phenomena in the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]]|the [[lightstorm chamber]] on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]}}
A '''lightstorm''' was a massive electromagnetic wave that occurred in the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]]. Lightstorms were hundreds of [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] in diameter, and were formed by the build up of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] and ionic charges. The lightstorms could easily swallow entire [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]], leaving minimal amounts of debris.
